instruction: Cinematic film still, medium-wide shot. Inside a bright dance studio with wooden floors and large windows, two people perform aerobics. In the foreground left, the woman in the white long-sleeve top and shorts (R4) is seen from behind in a low squat with one leg raised. In the background right, the man in the blue t-shirt and red headband (R2) stands in profile, performing a synchronized high-knee kick. Natural daylight streams through the windows, illuminating the warm wooden floor and casting soft shadows. The shot has a shallow depth of field, keeping the background sharp while the foreground figure is slightly soft.
